test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

______is the reason for this chaos?
solution: The correct answer is '**what'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The given sentence is an interrogative sentence. • Let's see the meanings of the Wh- words- • **Why-** for what reason किस कारण से • **Whom-** used instead of "who" as the object of a verb or preposition क्रिया या पूर्वसर्ग की वस्तु के रूप में "कौन" के बजाय प्रयोग किया जाता है • **What-** used to ask for information about people or things लोगों या चीजों के बारे में जानकारी मांगते थे • **When- **at what time; at the time at which कितने बजे; जिस समय • *Example- What books did you buy?* • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is** Option 3 i.e. what.** **So the correct sentence is-** ***What** is the reason for this chaos?* 42:T616, The correct answer is **'that'**
